name: Confusion Spell
slug: A confusion spell left Gerk unable to act.
description: Confusion Spell is a spell that can cause a creature to become confused and unable to act normally.

log.summary: During this session, Gerk was affected by Confusion Spell after failing a Wisdom saving throw. The effect left him dumbfounded and unable to move or take actions at the time described.
notes: The magical event caused Gerk to be affected by a confusion spell after he failed his Wisdom saving throw.
The effect left Gerk dumbfounded and unable to move or take actions at the time described.
